blocks.text: We have html for the global default block page which resource [zia_end_user_notification](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/zscaler/zia/latest/docs/resources/zia_end_user_notification) uses the arg `custom_text`. We have inline vars used in the html/js code to read values

blocks.item: terraform apply with window.onload should not throw a 406 error (issue exists on 4.4.8+)
terraform plan with 4.4.9/10 should show NO CHANGES instead of trying to replace all text ignoring heredoc indentation

blocks.text: With zia 4.4.8 when window.onload function call is made `terraform apply` fails with a 406 error from zscaler API.
Adding this snippet via the WEBGUI works fine and make the page function when the target cells match the 4 defined zscaler categories.

blocks.text: terraform plan/apply wants to remove ALL lines and push all back in with no indention (regardless of chomp usage) so it does not respect our heredoc properly. The inline code above ideally is going to move to a file("${path.module}/enduser-global-block.html") so its easier to manage and maintain and can be parsed as native html.
@(user) This is an api issue and has been escalated. The API does not support JavaScript tags in the payload.
@(user)  - does this need to be split into 2 distinct issues then?

blocks.item: there's still a problem with 4.4.9/10 and not respecting heredoc format

even if we remove indentation and left justify content above then when zia 4.4.9/10 hit the terraform escape characters `$${` to pass the java vars thru - it wants to do a change and swap back to escape from native `${` result.  This doesnt seem to be a problem on 4.4.8 and lower. Something seems to not accommodate the[ tf escape chars](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/expressions/strings) (i've only tested the `${`
as far as the API; does the WEBUI not send the input via that same API call under the hood?

blocks.text: @(user) WebUI and API are not the same. An internal BUG issue has been raised with our engineering team and is being looked at. We'll provide an update once we hear back from them.

As for the heredoc indentation, the provider sets the HCL as returned by the API. If there are problem still problems please contact Zscaler support and make reference of this GitHub Issue. The heredoc is working in our dev environment as designed, despite the javascrit tag issue mentioned previously.
